diagnosis: Serous borderline tumour of the peritoneum
legend: Cystic lesion of the peritoneum with a fibrous wall showing papillae and psammoma bodies. Focally, the fibrous tissue is densely infiltrated by inflammatory cells.

diagnosis: Serous borderline tumour of the peritoneum
legend: The lesion consists of multiple papillae and large psammomatous calcifications, partially in the stroma of the papillae.

diagnosis: Serous borderline tumour of the peritoneum
legend: The papillae are covered by proliferative serous epithelium, which shows mild atypia, tufting, and detachment from the surface.

diagnosis: Serous borderline tumour of the peritoneum
legend: The dense fibrous tissue contains small psammoma bodies and glandular structures.
